layout.$description: Semantic measures for constraints attached directly to Mash SurfaceTree nodes. Whether a measure is a minimum, preferred, or maximum value belongs to the node recipe, not to the token name.

zero.$description: A zero minimum that permits a nested region to shrink and scroll correctly.

glyph.$description: A compact icon, indicator, or spinner measure.

control.$description: The default compact interactive block or inline measure.

compact.$description: A compact supporting region or short value measure.

supporting.$description: A small supporting region or minimum workspace pane measure.

panel.$description: A supporting panel's preferred or minimum inline measure.

inspector.$description: A contextual inspector's preferred or maximum inline measure.

dialog.$description: A focused dialog or confirmation surface's maximum inline measure.

measure.$description: A readable maximum line or form measure.

content.$description: A broad content surface's maximum inline measure.

record.$description: A broad structured record surface's maximum inline measure.
